title: GATE Approved Feed Registry (C18)
description: Signed registry of approved external feeds for the C18 provenance chain check. A provenance_uri using the gate-feed:// scheme resolves its <feed_id> against the active registry; entries authorise the feed to write into the named content classes. The registry is a signed authorisation artifact; the policy at policies/memory/c18_quality.rego verifies registry_hash against the registry hash recorded in each quality_decision before honouring a chain-check pass. The content_classes_authorised values MUST match the operator's content_class vocabulary maintained alongside the C18 quality bundle; the schema does not enforce the cross-reference because the vocabulary is operator-owned, but a quarterly registry review verifies it. This schema sets additionalProperties to false (deviating from the v1.3 repo-wide permissive default) because the registry is a security-critical signed artifact where any undeclared field could be used to smuggle unverified authorisation past audit. The signing model and length-match constraint between signing_key_ids and signatures match break_glass_record exactly; the verification policy enforces the array length match.

registry_version.description: Semver string identifying the registry version. Bumped on every entry add, modify, or remove.

registry_hash.description: Stable hash over the canonical-JSON serialisation of the registry body excluding the signatures field. Recorded in every quality_decision event via feed_registry_hash so the chain-check decision is replayable.

last_updated_at.description: Wall-clock time of the most recent registry edit.

feed_id.description: Stable identifier for the feed. Used as the <feed_id> path component in gate-feed:// provenance URIs.

feed_name.description: Human-readable name of the feed for the operator registry UI and audit reports.

verification_mechanism.description: Mechanism the policy uses to verify the feed's content. public_key: signature verification against the key in verification_payload. published_manifest: hash match against the manifest at the URL in verification_payload. signed_endpoint: signature on the resolved content from the endpoint in verification_payload.

verification_payload.description: Polymorphic string whose format depends on verification_mechanism. For public_key: PEM-encoded public key or key fingerprint. For published_manifest: URL of the manifest plus the manifest hash. For signed_endpoint: HTTPS endpoint URL plus the public key for endpoint signature verification. The per-mechanism format is documented separately in the C18 implementation guide; the schema treats this as an opaque string for v1.4.

last_validated_at.description: Wall-clock time of the most recent manual or automated validation of this entry. Entries older than a configured staleness threshold are flagged for review.

content_classes_authorised.description: Content classes the feed is authorised to write into. Values MUST match the operator's content_class vocabulary maintained alongside the C18 quality bundle. Cross-reference is enforced operationally, not at schema level.

entries.description: Approved feed entries. Order is not significant for verification; the registry is queried by feed_id. feed_id MUST be unique across entries; uniqueness is enforced in the verification policy, not at schema level (JSON Schema uniqueItems compares whole objects and would not catch two entries sharing a feed_id but differing in other fields). The registry is single-instance per operator in v1.4: there is no registry_id field and the C18 policy assumes one active approved_feed_registry per tenant deployment. Multi-registry support is a candidate for v1.5 and would land as an optional registry_id field with a documented v1.4-compatibility default.

signing_key_ids.description: Identifiers of the signing keys used to produce signatures. One entry per signature in the signatures array, in the same order. Length match enforced in the verification policy.

signatures.description: Cryptographic signatures over the canonical-JSON registry body excluding the signatures field itself. The verification policy MUST validate all signatures against the keys listed in signing_key_ids before honouring registry contents. The number of signatures and signing_key_ids must match; this length match is enforced in the verification policy, not at schema level.

gate_version.description: GATE framework version under which this registry version was issued (e.g. "1.4").
